title: Reproducibility package for One-port Liouvillian sensing: critical dynamics, measurement information, and collective-mode visibility
description: Source code, derived experimental tables, deterministic numerical outputs, and figure-generation scripts for the study 'One-port Liouvillian sensing: critical dynamics, measurement information, and collective-mode visibility'. The original experimental raw data are referenced externally and are not redistributed.
